stem: 4-Methylphenol is treated with $\text{CHCl}_3$ and aqueous $\text{NaOH}$, followed by acidification. What is the major product?

verdicts.working: Reimer–Tiemann formylation places CHO ortho to the phenolic OH. The two ortho positions in 4-methylphenol are equivalent; naming the product as a benzaldehyde gives OH at 2 and methyl at 5.

working:
Reimer–Tiemann reaction introduces $-\text{CHO}$ ortho to $-\text{OH}$.\nIn 4-methylphenol, the two ortho positions are equivalent.\nNumbering the product from the aldehyde carbon gives $-\text{OH}$ at C-2 and $-\text{CH}_3$ at C-5.

Independent check: Reimer–Tiemann formylation places CHO ortho to the phenolic OH. The two ortho positions in 4-methylphenol are equivalent; naming the product as a benzaldehyde gives OH at 2 and methyl at 5.
solution: The Reimer–Tiemann reaction introduces $-\text{CHO}$ ortho to the phenolic $-\text{OH}$. The two ortho positions in 4-methylphenol are equivalent; numbering the product as a benzaldehyde gives $-\text{OH}$ at C-2 and $-\text{CH}_3$ at C-5, yielding 2-hydroxy-5-methylbenzaldehyde.
